Welcome to your new project! 🎉

This is a fresh notebook where you can experiment, practice, and build
whatever you like. The workshop notebooks are still in `notebooks/` if you
ever want to refer back to them.

## Load some data

Let's load the tidyverse and a built-in dataset to play with:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Palmer penguins — a classic starter dataset
library(palmerpenguins)
head(penguins)
```

## Try something

Edit the code below or ask me to add something new!

```{r}
penguins |>
  drop_na() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin body mass by species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body mass (g)"
  )
```

---

> **Tip:** If you want to use a dataset you upload, put the file in the
> `data/` folder and read it with `read_csv("data/your-file.csv")`.
